title: A Season Without Rain
text: The reservoir is shrinking. Farmers ask for water, while the wetland also needs protection.

choices.label: Share water fairly
choices.description: Everyone accepts a smaller ration.

choices.label: Protect the wetland
choices.description: Endure scarcity now so the water cycle can recover.

delayed.message: The protected wetland holds new rainfall

choices.label: Sell private access
choices.description: Gain supplies, but exclude neighbours.

title: The Factory Offer
text: A company offers quick supplies if it may release waste near the river.

choices.label: Accept without limits
choices.description: Receive plenty today and leave pollution for tomorrow.

choices.label: Require clean methods
choices.description: A smaller agreement protects the common good.

choices.label: Build a local cooperative
choices.description: Sacrifice materials to create shared work.

delayed.message: The cooperative shares its first harvest

title: A Neighbour's House Fire
text: A family has lost its home. Rebuilding will consume supplies saved for the island.

choices.label: Rebuild together
choices.description: Give wood and food; no neighbour stands alone.

choices.label: Offer temporary shelter
choices.description: Provide enough help without exhausting reserves.

choices.label: Protect our own stores
choices.description: Keep every resource, but abandon solidarity.

title: Pests in the Forest
text: Insects threaten young trees. A strong chemical is fast; patient restoration is safer.

choices.label: Use strong chemicals
choices.description: Save timber now but harm other species.

choices.label: Restore biodiversity
choices.description: Use timber to create habitats for natural predators.

delayed.message: Birds return and control the pests

title: A Surplus Harvest
text: The farm has more food than expected. The island must decide who benefits.

choices.label: Share with families
choices.description: Distribute the surplus according to need.

choices.label: Save seed and soil
choices.description: Prepare for future seasons.

delayed.message: Saved seed strengthens the next harvest

choices.label: Sell at the highest price
choices.description: Build reserves while poorer families struggle.

title: Storm Over Haven Island
text: Heavy winds approach. There is not enough time to protect every place equally.

choices.label: Protect vulnerable homes
choices.description: Use timber where people face the greatest danger.

choices.label: Strengthen the riverbank
choices.description: Protect homes and habitats through natural barriers.

choices.label: Protect the storehouse
choices.description: Preserve supplies but leave outer homes exposed.

title: New Families Arrive
text: Families displaced by flooding ask to join the community.

choices.label: Welcome and share
choices.description: Use supplies and invite everyone to contribute.

choices.label: Welcome a smaller group
choices.description: Balance hospitality with current capacity.

choices.label: Close the shore
choices.description: Keep supplies but turn neighbours away.

title: The Quiet Spring
text: A clear spring is discovered in the forest. It can be protected or exploited.

choices.label: Create a shared reserve
choices.description: Protect the source and guarantee fair access.

choices.label: Bottle and sell it
choices.description: Gain resources quickly from a common gift.

title: A Divided Council
text: The council argues over whether farms or habitats should receive the next water release.

choices.label: Hold a listening circle
choices.description: Spend time seeking a fair compromise.

choices.label: Prioritise farms
choices.description: Secure food now while habitats dry.

choices.label: Prioritise habitats
choices.description: Restore nature while accepting a smaller harvest.
